job: Maes Y Felin, Glan Conwy - Powys

stages.title: Raft and raft-edge ICF
stages.desc: The raft and its edge AS PER THE ARCHITECTURAL DRAWINGS (section A-A: 257.2 RC slab on 2 x 100 PIR on 150 Type 3 MOT); one course (457.2) of Nudura 6in XR35 round the edge - the single-sided, unassembled panel edge that forms the raft.

stages.title: Ground-floor ICF and partitions
stages.desc: Nudura 6in XR35 external walls to the L1 / L2 form joint (2,743.2), openings with the 25 mm external overfly and timber closers (no end caps, no lintels), and the ground-floor timber stud partitions (design assumption, drawn as Beech's plans).

stages.title: First floor and stair
stages.desc: 253 metal-web joists @ 600 top-hung on cut-down Strong-Tie ICF ledgers, 22 deck (joist ledger by the engineer), the timber straight-flight stair (13 x 200 / 223) and the bulkhead store (design assumptions).

stages.title: First-floor ICF and partitions
stages.desc: Nudura first-floor walls to the eaves (5,029.2 flat, plate 5,076), gables raked under the ladder, openings as the ground floor, and the first-floor timber stud partitions.

stages.title: Roof structure
stages.desc: Fink trussed rafters @ 600, 35 deg, with 47 x 122 TR26 gable ladders and timber closers on 47 x 150 wall plates (design assumption, for the truss manufacturer).

stages.title: Windows and doors
stages.desc: UPVC windows and doors tight to the back of the 25 overfly; front doors with vision panel, letter plate and peephole; obscure glazing, escape casements and safety glazing as Beech's schedule.
